newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Party withdraws from Bolivian governing coalition.
newsitem.headline: Party withdraws from Bolivian governing coalition.

text.p: One of the parties of Bolivian President Gonzalo Sanchez de Lozada's coalition said it was withdrawing from the government Friday due to differences over new pension fund regulations.
Civic Solidarity Union Party (UCS) chief Johnny Fernandez said his party opposed the government's decision to make private pension administrators place part of their funds in a trust fund.
But the UCS will still form part of the incoming government of president-elect Hugo Banzer, who is due to take power August 6, Fernandez said.
A government spokesman called the UCS move "lamentable" but said it would not change its stance on the pension fund regulations.
